Separate error toasts from polite toasts by giving error toasts an `aria-live="assertive"` region and preventing them from auto-dismissing after five seconds so users can read them.
args.title: Announce error toasts assertively and do not auto-dismiss them

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

Error toasts should use an assertive live region so screen readers announce them immediately, and they should not auto-dismiss after five seconds so users have time to read them.
